label: Frozen document-discovery diagnostic: aggregate TextUnit dense scores per document and compare against hybrid top-50 at equal budget. Model-free. Production and default retriever unchanged.
hypothesis: Document discovery is the binding loss, and it can be reduced by aggregating all TextUnit scores per document instead of using only the best hit. This is a model-free diagnostic, not a retriever.
limitations: The discovery signal still uses the same dense embedding; only the aggregation changes. A ceiling that does not move means the signal, not the aggregation, is the bottleneck.
Equal-budget comparison is 50 examined TextUnits: hybrid top-50 versus 10 documents x 5 units.
DocumentRecall is measured against documents that have passage gold.
